title: Scrum Master
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**What this role is about:**

A Scrum Master is a facilitator who ensures a development team successfully follows Scrum framework principles. They do not act as traditional managers, but rather as servant leaders who guide the team through daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings. A core part of their role involves removing obstacles or blockers that slow down the team's progress. They also protect the team from external distractions and scope creep, allowing developers to focus entirely on their sprint goals. Scrum Masters coach both the team and the organization on agile practices to improve efficiency and collaboration. Ultimately, their main objective is to foster a self-organizing, high-performing team that continuously delivers value.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives for multiple software development teams
* Coach and mentor teams on Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe practices, enabling stronger self-organization and delivery excellence
* Proactively identify, track, and remove impediments that could impact sprint commitments and project milestones
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a prioritized, refined, and value-driven product backlog
* Communicate delivery status, risks, velocity trends, and performance metrics to stakeholders and engineering leadership
* Establish, monitor, and analyze Agile metrics including Velocity, Burndown, Cycle Time, and Cumulative Flow to drive continuous improvement

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**Requirements:**

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years experience in agile software development environments, preferrable in Scaled Agile (SAFe) setups
* Minimum 3 years of dedicated experience as a Scrum Master supporting multiple Agile teams
* Proven experience facilitating Agile delivery within global and cross-functional software engineering organizations.
* Strong coaching, facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities while driving delivery predictability and team performance
* Certifications like Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM II), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) and/or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) are a plus
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

**Mandatory:**

* Skills: Strong communication, leadership without authority, and problem-solving abilities.
* Tools:Hands-on experience of Jira, Confluence, or Trello.Good to have experience on Flutter (front end) and .NET (backend).
* Certification:Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or PMI-ACP.

**Anaplan Scrum Master**
------------------------

Johnson Controls is looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support Anaplan-driven planning work across business and technology teams. In this role, you will help teams deliver with clarity, keep priorities aligned, and improve how planning solutions move from ideas to release.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

This role is focused on guiding Agile delivery for Anaplan initiatives in a collaborative enterprise environment. You will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to keep delivery organized, transparent, and moving forward. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of experience who can bring structure, momentum, and steady facilitation to complex planning work.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and release planning.
* Partner with Product Owners to keep the backlog prioritized, clear, and ready for sprint execution.
* Translate business needs into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria that support Anaplan delivery.
* Coordinate across business users, Product Owners, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to maintain alignment on scope, dependencies, and delivery goals.
* Support UAT activities by helping validate delivered solutions against acceptance criteria and business expectations.
* Track impediments, risks, and delivery blockers, and help drive timely resolution.
* Protect the team from unnecessary scope creep and external disruptions while keeping stakeholders informed.
* Support transparency through delivery updates, sprint health indicators, and progress reporting.
* Encourage continuous improvement in planning, collaboration, and release readiness.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by keeping commitments visible, raising risks early, and following through on agreed actions.
* Stay close to the work by understanding the details of Anaplan delivery, removing blockers quickly, and helping the team focus on what matters most.
* Improve every day by using retrospectives, candid conversation, and practical problem-solving to strengthen flow, quality, and predictability.
* Win as one team by building trust across business and technology partners, respecting diverse perspectives, and supporting shared goals.
* Use Agile ceremonies and delivery data to keep the team aligned, informed, and ready for the next sprint.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 7+ years of professional experience, including proven experience as a Scrum Master in an Agile environment.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile frameworks.
* Experience translating business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience supporting Anaplan initiatives or enterprise planning solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Ability to influence without authority and navigate change effectively.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
* Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with financial forecasting, commercial planning, workforce planning, or other enterprise planning processes in Anaplan.
* Exposure to Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, or similar collaboration tools.
* Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, and delivery metrics reporting.
* Familiarity with The Anaplan Way or similar structured planning delivery methods.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of planning, technology, and business delivery, helping teams turn requirements into practical Anaplan solutions. This role offers meaningful collaboration, visibility across functions, and the chance to strengthen Agile ways of working in a supportive environment.
